The 'pan' body is circular and covered in small, square glass or ceramic tiles in various colors (green, blue, black, gold) arranged in geometric patterns. In the center of the pan's interior is a sculpted, orange-colored face with a distressed expression. To the right of the face are white rectangular tiles resembling piano keys and a row of metallic spheres. The handle is wooden with a metal ferrule connecting it to the pan body. The object rests on a dark, textured fabric surface.
